home.intro: I'm a web developer with a passion for creating seamless user experiences. I build accessible, pixel-perfect digital experiences for the web.
home.personalProjectsSubtitle: Personal projects I build in my spare time — including this platform.
home.p1: Hi! My name is Rafael, and welcome to my personal website! I'm a builder from Campina Grande, currently living in João Pessoa. I'm 29 and work as a Senior Software Engineer.
home.p2: I'm currently building {d2brain}, and I'm also working on other products like {dodoro} and more that you can find in the {projects} section. I like trying new things, and in this era, building stuff is the best way to do it.
home.p3: I have 8+ years of experience specializing in full-stack web development. I've collaborated with global teams to build scalable solutions, communicating effectively across cultures.
home.p4: In my spare time, I'm usually playing DotA 2, NBA 2K27, or Guild Wars 2. I also like working out and hanging out with my fiancée and our two cats. Lately, I've been really into prompting from my phone so I can watch things get built while I'm away from my computer. For that, I use {t3}.
